facts.label: Farm name
facts.value: Seethamount
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Padichira, Wayanad, Kerala, India
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Current farm condition
facts.value: Established mixed tree-crop farm
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Purpose
facts.value: Biodiversity, household self-reliance and income together
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Main farm area
facts.value: 2.41 acres; survey states 0.9753 ha
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Separate well parcel
facts.value: Additional to the main farm; parcel area unknown
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: General terrain
facts.value: Falls broadly from the western road side toward the east; local terraces and bunds
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Survey detail
facts.value: 27 March 2026; 1 m contours; stated 5 × 5 m grid
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Elevation and boundary reconciliation
facts.value: Datum, scale and coordinates unresolved. Atlas candidate boundary area differs from printed area; satellite 760 label conflicts with survey levels.
facts.locator: DWG candidate boundary and baseline §3 comparison
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Coconut population
facts.value: About 90 palms; reported count, not a mapped productive census
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Gliricidia population
facts.value: About 400 trees
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Coffee population
facts.value: Robusta reported; visually at least 1.5 acres of understorey; bush count unknown
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Pepper population
facts.value: About 100 older vines plus about 200 planted September–October 2026
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Individual plant map
facts.value: Complete species, living and bearing counts, and individual positions are not established
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Water source
facts.value: Open well on a separate lower parcel; pump nameplate confirms 2 HP
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Installed irrigation
facts.value: Approximately 40–59 sprinklers; no more than eight operated simultaneously
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Summer water capacity
facts.value: Discharge, water-level recovery, daily recoverable volume and summer reliability unknown
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Observed runoff
facts.value: Road water enters at the gate and follows access; house-platform water leaves the east edge
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Soil observations
facts.value: Dark topsoil beneath litter; sticky or clayey-feeling when wet. No known laboratory test.
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Crop-height light
facts.value: Mixed openings and shade; seasonal light totals unmeasured
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: House and caretaker site
facts.value: Old house remains; rebuilding not started. Caretaker house planned at former cowshed.
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Private access descends from the panchayat road; small-lorry access reported possible
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Retaining wall
facts.value: Cracks and bulging reported; professional structural condition assessment not supplied
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Typical hired labour
facts.value: About 5–10 person-days/month at about ₹850/person-day; owner labour additional
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Recorded coconut sale
facts.value: October 2026: 250 kg at ₹47/kg from one picking; annual yield and net income unknown
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Income objective
facts.value: Income is a goal; no numerical target established in this baseline
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Crop sharing with wildlife
facts.value: Some shared fruit and eaten leaves acceptable; acceptable loss levels not quantified
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

facts.label: Future enterprises
facts.value: Ponds, gardens, nursery and other enterprises appear as intentions requiring current confirmation
facts.locator: §13 Plans, kept separate from existing conditions
facts.note: Imported from baseline v1; not a new field verification.

questions.title: What is the farm like today?

questions.why: We should build on the farm you have, rather than assume a blank site.
